items.title: Sobi licenses Innate’s CTCL drug for up to $580m as it heads to Phase III
items.summary: Innate is planning to begin a Phase III confirmatory trial on lacutamab as it vies for the drug’s accelerated approval in a rare CTCL subset.

items.title: Innovent and Daiichi Sankyo sign deal for Vanflyta in China
items.summary: Innovent Biologics and Daiichi Sankyo have signed an exclusive agreement to commercialise Vanflyta, an oral type II FLT3 inhibitor, in China.

items.title: Energenesis and Taiwan Tanabe to develop ENERGI-F703DFU for DFUs
items.summary: Energenesis has signed a development agreement with Taiwan Tanabe for its investigational topical drug ENERGI-F703DFU to treat DFUs.

items.title: Tarsus joins Stargardt race to market with $800m Alkeus takeover
items.summary: Alongside Alkeus, companies like Belite Bio, Ocugen and Nanoscope are aiming to secure a place on the Stargardt market with no approved drugs.

items.title: Context drops bispecific T-cell engager on cost-cutting initiative
items.summary: Following the discontinuation of CT-95, Context will now focus on the two other BiTEs in its pipeline, CTIM-76 and CT-202.
